events.title: Fervor Rework, More Lessons, and New Look
events.summary: Fervor battles have been reworkedBreak guards and interrupt attacks. Playing notes wears down an enemy’s guard. Breaking it staggers them, cancels upcoming special attacks, and halves damage from missed notes. Enemies reset their guard after each stagger.New special attacks. Watch for marked notes that can poison you, steal coins, or deal heavy damage when missed. Break the enemy’s guard early to cancel them.A whale boss finale.
